info.name: UrbanNexus API Collection
info.description:
Comprehensive Postman collection for the UrbanNexus Spring Boot Backend.

Local demo seed credentials (data.sql):
- Admin: username=admin, password=Bhumika@1234
- Resident: username=jane_s, password=pwd123#
- Technician: username=tech_tom, password=pwd123#

These seed passwords are temporary: until an account runs 'Change Password', every other request returns 403 with code PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED. Changing the password revokes earlier tokens; the Change Password request saves the replacement token automatically.

Workflow: Run 'Login' first — the test script auto-saves the JWT to {{jwt_token}}.

request.description: Updates the caller's own profile. Residents: name, contact, no_of_members (number or numeric string). Technicians: name, contact, available; only the admin can change a technician's skill (403). SuperAdmin: username.

Allows any authenticated user (Resident, Technician, SuperAdmin) to change their own password. Requires the correct current password; the new password must differ from it and be at least 6 characters. This is the only call (besides Get My Profile) allowed while the account has a temporary password. The change revokes every earlier token, so the response carries a new one, which the test script stores in {{jwt_token}}. Returns 400 if currentPassword is wrong.

originalRequest.description: Allows any authenticated user (Resident, Technician, SuperAdmin) to change their own password. Requires the correct current password; the new password must differ from it and be at least 6 characters. This is the only call (besides Get My Profile) allowed while the account has a temporary password. The change revokes every earlier token, so the response carries a new one, which the test script stores in {{jwt_token}}. Returns 400 if currentPassword is wrong.

request.description: Creates a resident record and a linked login account. The response includes the generated username (name + residentId) and a random one-time temporary password, which must be changed at first login. The admin must share these credentials with the resident. New users cannot self-register — all accounts are provisioned by the admin.

originalRequest.description: Creates a resident record and a linked login account. The response includes the generated username (name + residentId) and a random one-time temporary password, which must be changed at first login. The admin must share these credentials with the resident. New users cannot self-register — all accounts are provisioned by the admin.

request.description: Issues a new random one-time password for the resident's login, signs them out everywhere (all their tokens are revoked) and lifts any login lockout. The resident must change the password at next login. SuperAdmin only.

response.name: OK (200)

request.description: Deletes the resident with their login and bookings. Their invoices are kept and still show their name in the ledger. If they have unpaid invoices (Pending, Overdue or Under Review) the call returns 409 with code UNPAID_INVOICES, unpaid_count and unpaid_total; repeat it with ?write_off_unpaid=true to mark those invoices 'Written Off' and delete the resident.

response.name: OK (200)

request.description: Creates a technician record and a linked login account. The response includes the generated username (name + techId) and a random one-time temporary password, which must be changed at first login. The admin must share these credentials with the technician. New users cannot self-register — all accounts are provisioned by the admin. A tech_id that already exists returns 409 and the existing technician is left unchanged. If the generated username (name + id) is already taken, a _2, _3, ... suffix is added.

originalRequest.description: Creates a technician record and a linked login account. The response includes the generated username (name + techId) and a random one-time temporary password, which must be changed at first login. The admin must share these credentials with the technician. New users cannot self-register — all accounts are provisioned by the admin. A tech_id that already exists returns 409 and the existing technician is left unchanged. If the generated username (name + id) is already taken, a _2, _3, ... suffix is added.

request.description: Technicians can only mark assignments assigned to them as Completed (403 otherwise); the SuperAdmin can set any assignment to Assigned or Completed. Unknown statuses return 400 and unknown assignment ids 404.

Issues a new random one-time password for the technician's login, signs them out everywhere (all their tokens are revoked) and lifts any login lockout. The technician must change the password at next login. SuperAdmin only.

response.name: OK (200)
OK (200)

request.description: Adds an amenity with an admin-chosen amenity_id. An amenity_id that already exists returns 409 and the existing amenity is left unchanged. capacity is optional (no limit) but must be at least 1 when given.
Skills a resident can book (the technician price list), each with the GST-inclusive price of a visit. Residents and the SuperAdmin only.

Books the first available technician with the requested skill for the date (YYYY-MM-DD) and slot (1-3). A technician can hold only one assignment per date and slot, even under concurrent requests. Returns 409 if no technician with that skill is free, 400 for a missing or invalid skill, date or slot.

Books capacity_booked places (at least 1) at the amenity for the date (YYYY-MM-DD) and slot (1-3). Capacity counts all confirmed bookings already made for that date and slot; a request that does not fit returns 409 with the number of places left. Amenities without a capacity have no headcount limit.

Reports that the resident paid an unpaid invoice of theirs offline (UPI, bank transfer, cheque). The invoice moves to 'Under Review' and stays unpaid until the admin confirms it. 'reference' is required (max 100 characters). Returns 400 if the invoice is not the resident's or is not Pending/Overdue.

response.name: OK (200)

request.description: Marks an invoice as Paid once the money has been received: either a resident's submission that is Under Review, or an offline payment the admin records directly on a Pending/Overdue invoice.
Rejects a resident's submission that is Under Review. The reference is cleared and the invoice returns to Overdue if it is more than 30 days old, otherwise Pending.

response.name: OK (200)

request.description: pendingTickets counts technician jobs not yet completed plus amenity bookings from today on; paymentsToReview counts residents' reported payments awaiting confirmation; pendingLedger/overdueLedger are the GST-inclusive amounts owed.
